result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout/content issue with truncated text and one missing element in the popular section.

issues.description: Third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section has truncated text - 'Trattoria Piccol' appears cut off, likely should be 'Trattoria Piccolo'
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel layout or card width to ensure full restaurant names are visible, or implement text truncation with ellipsis (...) if space is constrained

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card in 'Popular right now' section is missing the restaurant name label - only the discount badge and image are visible
issues.suggestion: Add the restaurant name text below or overlaid on the image, similar to the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card above it
